paper_title: Frequency Ratio Measurements with 18-digit Accuracy Using a Network of Optical Clocks
notes: BACON collaboration paper reporting optical frequency ratios of 27Al+, 171Yb, and 87Sr clocks with fractional uncertainties of 6-8e-18. This is a pure metrology measurement paper: it reports the ratio values and their uncertainties but does NOT derive any exclusion limit on any axion/scalar/dark-matter coupling. The only mention of new physics (dark matter, fundamental constants) is a forward-looking statement in the conclusion that such clock-ratio measurements 'can be used as sensitive tests of the Standard Model and probes for new physics' -- no coupling bound, no drift limit on alpha/mu, and no dark-matter oscillation search is presented. Therefore no new measured coupling limit to report.
